content.text: Show summary Hide summary 🔥 Quick Facts The Unstoppable Chris Tomlin Leads Easter Worship 2026 Why Elevation Worship Dominates 2026 Playlists The Top 25 Easter Songs Reshaping Worship in April 2026 Beyond the Charts, What Worship Leaders Are Actually Singing How Will You Celebrate Easter 2026 with These Songs Sources Easter songs are dominating playlists today, with Chris Tomlin and Elevation Worship leading the charge. Just released, the top 25 worship tracks for April 5, 2026 reveal a powerful collection of resurrection anthems. What songs are churches singing this year, and why are these artists setting the tone for Easter worship everywhere. 🔥 Quick Facts Number 1 song: Holy Forever by Chris Tomlin dominates 2026 charts Elevation Worship: Three songs in top 20 including I Know A Name Release window: Most trending songs launched between February and March 2026 Streaming dominance: Essential Worship playlists exceed 6,400 total saves on Spotify The Unstoppable Chris Tomlin Leads Easter Worship 2026 Chris Tomlin has claimed the top position with Holy Forever, a penetrating anthem that explores Christ’s eternal nature. The breakthrough track features Tomlin’s signature acoustic warmth paired with modern production. Praise by Elevation Worship and I Know A Name round out the elite tier of songs reshaping worship landscapes this spring. According to WorshipFuel, churches are prioritizing songs about redemption and resurrection power. Charity Gayle’s Thank You Jesus For The Blood sits at number 2, emphasizing the cross as the foundation of hope. This shift toward blood-focused theology reflects a deeper theological movement in contemporary worship circles. Why Elevation Worship Dominates 2026 Playlists The North Carolina-based collective maintains remarkable momentum with multiple chart entries. I Know A Name features Chris Brown and Brandon Lake, creating infectious melodies that hook listeners instantly. Elevation Rhythm’s complementary arrangements offer fresh interpretations of ancient hymns. What makes Elevation unique this Easter season is their blend of contemporary production with deeply theological lyrics. Resurrecting and Welcome Resurrection explore kingdom power in ways that feel both intimate and corporate. Musicians report these songs structure easily into worship setlists without sacrificing prophetic edge. The Top 25 Easter Songs Reshaping Worship in April 2026 Rank Song Title Artist 1. Holy Forever Chris Tomlin 2. Thank You Jesus For The Blood Charity Gayle 3. I Know A Name Elevation Worship 4. He Arose Tommee Profitt & Phil Wickham 5. All Hail King Jesus, The King Is In The Room, Praise, Love of God, The Blood Various Artists “These songs embody the journey we take every Holy Week, from Jesus’s humble entrance into Jerusalem, to the cross, to resurrection. This list features songs from Brooke Ligertwood, Phil Wickham, Red Rocks Worship, and more.” According to Lead Worship Well, a collaborative song curation platform Beyond the Charts, What Worship Leaders Are Actually Singing Phil Wickham’s Sunday Is Coming and Living Hope continue their reign as cultural touchstones for resurrection theology. Bethel Music contributes All Hail King Jesus and The Blood, emphasizing ancient liturgy through modern soundscapes. Passion delivers What He’s Done and What A Worthy Name, focusing on Christ’s finished work. Church music databases reveal CCLI tracking shows churches adapting newer songs faster than ever before. Gateway Worship’s Covered By The Blood has emerged as the surprise cross-generational hit, appealing to both traditional and contemporary congregations. The song’s bridge section, emphasizing covenant promises, resonates with Easter’s core theology. How Will You Celebrate Easter 2026 with These Songs Building your personal Easter worship experience requires mixing corporate anthems with intimate reflections. Start with Holy Forever for meditative moments, then transition into high-energy tracks like Praise and I Know A Name. Include Phil Wickham’s slower tempos for prayer and worship. Streaming platforms have created curated playlists on Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube featuring hourlong compilations of top Easter songs 2026. Essential Worship’s playlist has accumulated over 6,400 user saves, indicating mass adoption across denominations. Are you discovering new favorites, or returning to beloved classics this resurrection season.
